 [[File:Inv07-Turtles.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Turtles on [[Artorias]]]]
'''Turtles''' were a group of [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] creatures. They were similar to [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] in several senses, including the head, but Yinchorri were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] while turtles were not.<ref name="yinch">[[Star Wars (1977) 86|''Star Wars'' (1977) 86]]; [[Jedi Council: Acts of War #1]]''</ref>

Known turtles included the [[Gorskin|giant sea turtle]] of [[Dorumaa]],<ref name="Dorumaa">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> the [[puffer turtle]] of [[Mezhra Station|Clak'dor VIII]]<ref name="clakdor">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Trouble on Cloud City]]''</ref> and the [[Cerulean Turtle]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="cerulean">{{TORcite|type=item|Cerulean Turtle|Manaan reputation vendor}}</ref> Aquatic turtles also lived in the [[Great Sea of Artorias|Great Sea]] of [[Artorias]].<ref name="Invasion: Rescues 2">[[Invasion: Rescues 2|''Invasion: Rescues'' 2]]</ref>
